title: WhatsApp — verified before introduced
body:
Assalamu alaikum 🤍

There is a duʻa many of us have made since we were young — for a spouse who brings peace, for a marriage built on mercy and love, for a nikah that begins the right way.

Date Khaas was built for that duʻa.

Here’s what makes it different:

✅ Every profile is verified *before* it ever reaches you
🔒 Your photos are private by default — you choose who sees them
👨‍👩‍👧 Invite your wali to join the conversation from day one
🚫 No fake profiles, no strangers, no shortcuts

This is not another app asking you to scroll and swipe. It is a careful, dignified path — the way it should be done.

Join free → https://datekhaas.com/join

May Allah place barakah in your search. 🤍

Reply STOP to opt out.

research_sources.insight: 77.8% of Muslim singles now use digital platforms to find a spouse, making platform trust the single highest-stakes differentiator in the market.

NikahForever — a leading competitor — has documented user complaints that shortlisted profiles were married or fake, and profiles were not cross-verified. This is a credibility gap Date Khaas can own.
Top converting trust signals in Muslim matrimony 2026: photo blur defaults, mandatory ID verification, wali invite features, and aggressive profile moderation — in that order.
Scam avoidance education is circulating widely in the Muslim community: red flags include single-photo profiles, immediate moves to WhatsApp, and any money request. Users are on high guard.
June 2026 is within the active Muslim wedding season (peak months: April–October). NRI diaspora in Gulf, UK, and US are a major active segment.
Shaadi.com and NikahForever both claim 'verified profiles' — but verification is not ID-based or pre-approval; photo privacy is often a paid-tier feature, not a default.
